global_vibe: Terminal-Next, Bloomberg-esque, precise, objective, dense, brutalist. Function over form.

usage.labels: text-[10px] sm:text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-muted-foreground

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use IBM Plex Mono for ALL financial data, tickers, tables, and pipeline logs. Use IBM Plex Sans ONLY for markdown prose and main page headers. Ensure all numbers use `tabular-nums`. Install and use Google Fonts for these.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Strict adherence to the 10% Grey base. No gradients. No transparency on backgrounds. Color is data: only use green/red/yellow for semantic financial meaning.

grids_and_layouts.details: Dense, compact, edge-to-edge feeling. Use `border-collapse` style grid layouts where adjacent widgets share a 1px border. No rounded corners (`rounded-none`).

sections.sidebar: w-64 fixed left, displaying report history (tickers, dates).
sections.main_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-px bg-border (creates 1px grid lines when children have bg-background).

Cards.styles: bg-surface rounded-none border border-border p-4. No shadows.
Cards.instructions: Avoid Shadcn default rounded corners. Use raw divs with sharp borders for terminal feel.

CommandInput.styles: bg-black border border-border text-primary font-mono text-lg p-4 rounded-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary w-full
CommandInput.instructions: Design like a terminal prompt. Needs data-testid='query-input'.

PipelineVisualization.instructions: Show agent progress as terminal logs (e.g., `[✓] Retriever... [⟳] Extractor...`). Use color coding for status.

StructuredDataTables.styles: text-xs font-mono tabular-nums. Header uppercase tracking-widest.
StructuredDataTables.instructions: Left-align text, right-align numbers. Use `border-b border-border/50` for rows.

ToneGauge.instructions: Use a simple horizontal stacked bar or semi-circle gauge. Colors: Bullish (#00E676), Bearish (#FF0055).

FactCheckBadges.styles: rounded-none text-[10px] uppercase font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 border
FactCheckBadges.instructions: Verified: `border-bullish text-bullish bg-transparent`. Flagged: `border-bearish text-bearish bg-transparent`.

MarkdownViewer.styles: font-sans prose prose-invert prose-p:text-sm prose-a:text-brand prose-a:no-underline hover:prose-a:underline
MarkdownViewer.instructions: Format citations as clickable superscript numbers `[1]`. Add data-testid='markdown-content'.

Tabs.styles: h-8 rounded-none bg-transparent border-b border-border p-0
Tabs.instructions: Active tab gets border-b-2 border-primary text-primary. No background.

visual_enhancers.textures: None. Keep it stark and digital.
visual_enhancers.borders: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid. Do not use Glassmorphism for this app.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Invert colors for primary buttons (bg-white text-black).
motion_and_interactions.animations: Instant. Minimal animation. Terminal users prefer zero-latency feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratio requirements are met. Text on `#0A0A0A` must be at least `#888888` for secondary, `#E0E0E0` for primary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='ticker-submit-button'`, `data-testid='fact-check-badge'`).

media_and_images.instructions: Use sparingly. This is a data terminal.

avatars.description: Professional finance avatar (Male) - Use for user profile placeholder
Professional finance avatar (Female) - Use for user profile placeholder

backgrounds.description: Abstract lines. Only use if absolutely necessary for an empty state background with 5% opacity and grayscale filter.

dependencies.notes: Use Phosphor icons for dense data dashboards.
